normalization_plan.reason: Function argument localizes into the single privileged setter that consumes it.
Mint type argument only influences the mintNifty state transition.
Mint count argument only influences the mintNifty arithmetic and loop.
ERC165 identifier argument is only compared inside supportsInterface.
Spender argument is only used by the approval predicate function.
Opaque data argument is only forwarded through the receiver check.
Local holds the registry result that gates the modifier execution.
Local hour is derived from block.timestamp solely within _bustOfZeus.
Local elapsed-year value is only used to index artifact02.
Local weekday index is only used to index artifact03.
Local first token ID is computed and consumed only inside mintNifty.
